spec_evidence.checked: Cached snapshots, token-level: OLD error_link_description.method enum = [CONNECT, DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT]; NEW = [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH] (CONNECT/HEAD/OPTIONS dropped). The sibling link_description schema keeps the full 8-value enum in BOTH versions — the shrink is scoped to error-body links only. POST /v2/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}/send 202: OLD content (application/json + multipart/mixed) -> #/components/schemas/202-response whose only property is links (array of link_description); NEW content -> #/components/schemas/link_description directly, resolved props {href, rel, method}.

fix.migration_guide: links[].method = HEAD on POST /v2/invoicing/templates: the error-body HATEOAS link schema (error_link_description) no longer documents CONNECT/HEAD/OPTIONS in its method enum — the documented set is now GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH (token-verified). Note the non-error link_description schema keeps the full 8-value enum, so this only affects links read from ERROR responses. If your error handler dispatches on link.method for the removed verbs, delete those branches; navigation via the surviving verbs is unchanged.
fix.example_after:
// CONNECT/HEAD/OPTIONS are no longer documented values for error-body link methods.
for (const l of err.links) follow(l);
